title: As Prince Harry and Meghan Depart California for the U.K., Their Neighbors Shrug
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle self exiled to the ultrawealthy enclave of Montecito in 2020. “They wave. They drive. They close the gates,” a neighbor said.
